mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `t_ebook_record`(`user_id`, `ebook_id`, `chapter_id`, `read_progress`, `read_time`, `is_latest`, `create_time`, `update_time`) VALUES (#{userId}, #{eBookId}, #{chapterId}, #{readProgress}, now(), #{isLatest}, now(), now());
mapper.select: SELECT rr.id, rr.user_id, rr.ebook_id, rr.chapter_id, rr.read_progress, DATE_FORMAT(rr.read_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as read_time, rr.is_latest, DATE_FORMAT(rr.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time, DATE_FORMAT(rr.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as update_time, n.title AS title, n.url AS url, c.title AS chapter_title FROM t_ebook_record rr LEFT JOIN t_ebook n ON rr.ebook_id = n.id LEFT JOIN t_ebook_item c ON rr.chapter_id = c.id WHERE rr.user_id =#{userId} ORDER BY rr.read_time DESC
